title: Five summands and the separate conditional continuation
interpretation: Directed edges run from mathematical premises to conclusions. The two top conclusions have different scopes. This graph does not assert an unconditional all-index theorem.
scope_notes: The sharp fifth-index theorem assumes the published unrestricted fourth-index bound C4 <= CE; its conclusion is non-strict C5 <= CE.
The fifth-index theorem uses its continuous companion proofs and complete exact certificates. File hashes identify proof objects but do not establish their mathematical truth.
The gap-free corner is proved directly for every standardized iid law in its stated moment rectangle, without support, contact, C4 or a predecessor premise.
The branch for indices six and above retains A6, F and T10 explicitly. A6 and F are required at each of the indices six through nine.
The continuation uses the independent coarse fifth-index seed C5 < 429/1000, not the sharp fifth-index theorem. There is no edge from sharp C5 to the continuation.
